clips.title: The story
paras: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Mirkfallon Lake fills a basin beneath Windshear Crag. Native wildlife crowds its waters and banks, from aggressive slimes to thunder lizards and wyverns.

Mirkfallon Lake lies at the center of the Stonetalon range, between the passes to Webwinder Path in the south and Stonetalon Peak in the north. Runoff from the highlands feeds its waters, drawing thunder lizards down to drink and wyverns from their high roosts. Strange slimes bubble in the lake, making the crossing hazardous for travelers.

Paths cross the lake basin in every direction. To the east, rocky tracks climb into Windshear Crag and the logging operations deep in its forested valleys. North of the lake, travelers climb toward night elven sanctums and tauren heights. Southward, the route skirts venomous spider hollows. Explorers and scouts crossing the contested mountains must reckon with the shifting dangers around the lake.
